verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents user-defined automated workflows through Pipelines, AI-powered workflows triggered from the pipeline, and customizable merge checks. It also updates Jira issue statuses automatically when a commit includes the issue key. However, the evidence never describes a general event-to-action rules engine or which events can trigger Pipelines, so event-based rule definition is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit rule/automation builder with documented event triggers and conditions, documentation of the supported trigger events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Use our built-in CI/CD tool, Bitbucket Pipelines, to create powerful, automated workflows.
Trigger AI-powered workflows to automate tedious tasks: clean up feature flags, update docs, draft release notes, fix flaky tests, and more — all from your pipeline.
Enforce code quality policies and compliance requirements across the organization with standardized, customizable merge checks.
when you include your issue key in commits, your Jira issue statuses update automatically.
